findings.title: Audio quality score improved after cleaning
findings.statement: The audio data quality score increased from 57.1 out of 100 before cleaning to 98.5 out of 100 after cleaning.
findings.recommendation: Use the cleaned dataset for model training to benefit from the higher quality score.

findings.title: Dataset size reduced during cleaning
findings.statement: The cleaning process removed 8 clips in total from an initial count of 31 clips, leaving 23 clips.
findings.recommendation: Review the removed clips to ensure no critical training data was lost.

findings.title: Class imbalance persists after cleaning
findings.statement: The class imbalance ratio across the command categories is 2.0 after cleaning, with 10 yes clips, 8 no clips, and 5 stop clips.
findings.recommendation: Apply data augmentation or class weighting strategies to handle the remaining class imbalance.

findings.title: Label mismatches detected in raw data
findings.statement: Transcript comparison identified 3 label mismatches where the transcription did not match the folder label, which remain present in the final 23 cleaned clips unless manually removed.
findings.recommendation: Manually inspect and relabel or remove the clips where transcripts do not match folder labels.

findings.title: Raw audio contains duplicates and corrupt files
findings.statement: The raw audio contained 1 corrupt file, 1 exact extra copy, and 2 near extra copies.
findings.recommendation: Ensure automated ingestion pipelines continue to filter out corrupt files and duplicates.

narrative.headline: Dataset quality improved to 98.5 after cleaning, but small size and class imbalance require attention for keyword spotting.
narrative.executive_summary: The speech_commands.zip dataset quality score increased from 57.1 out of 100 before cleaning to 98.5 out of 100 after cleaning. The cleaning process removed 8 clips in total from an initial count of 31 clips, leaving 23 clips. Transcript comparison identified 3 label mismatches where the transcription did not match the folder label. Additionally, the class imbalance ratio across the command categories is 2.0 after cleaning, with 10 yes clips, 8 no clips, and 5 stop clips.
next_steps: Manually review and resolve the 3 label mismatches identified in the dataset.
Address the class imbalance across the 10 yes clips, 8 no clips, and 5 stop clips.
Incorporate data augmentation to compensate for the small final dataset size of 23 clips.
